anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: He likened the passion to the serpent, not to the Passover.

pass_a_gloss: For if he had said: As Moses made the pascha in Egypt, so must Christ suffer, it would have been undeniable that a type of the pascha had come to be; since he likened his passion to the serpent hung upon wood, his passion would be a type of nothing else than this.
pass_b_english: For if he had said: "As Moses made the Passover in Egypt, so must Christ suffer," (John 3:14) it would have been undeniable that it had become a type of the Passover. Since he likened his passion to the serpent hung on wood, his passion would be a type of nothing else but this.
source_text: Εἰ γὰρ εἰρήκει· "Ὥσπερ ἐποίησεν τὸ πάσχα Μωϋσῆς ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ, οὕτως δε[ῖ παθ]εῖν τὸν Χ(ριστό)ν", ἀναντίρρητο[ν δ’οὖ]ν τι τύπον τοῦ πάσχ[α γεγ]ονέναι· ἐπειδὴ τὸ πάθ[ος ὡ]μοίωσεν αὐτοῦ τῷ κρ[ε]μα[σθέ]ντι ἐπὶ ξύλου ὄφει, οὐ[κ ἄ]λλου τινὸς ἢ τούτου τύπο[ς ε]ἴη τὸ πάθος αὐτοῦ.
